question: Should PR #102054 carry the broad delivery-queue-owned media handoff as the supported fix for Codex generated-image duplicate/drop behavior, or should it be narrowed to typed Codex result-byte transfer before merge?
rationale: The typed Codex result-byte fix is backed by upstream Codex source, but the PR also creates a new durable media lifecycle that changes outbound queue, gateway, backup, recovery, and channel delivery behavior beyond the narrow bug.

options.title: Rebase and prove broad handoff
options.body: Resolve the conflicting branch, keep the durable media handoff, and require focused upgrade/recovery and live media-delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Codex transfer
options.body: Keep the typed result-byte persistence and duplicate suppression while deferring the durable queue-media lifecycle to a smaller owner-reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause for replacement path
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want issue #88307 or a different branch to own the broader generated-media duplicate-delivery solution.

recommendation.title: Rebase and prove broad handoff
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicting branch, keep the durable media handoff, and require focused upgrade/recovery and live media-delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest observed history across both the Codex app-server and outbound delivery queue boundaries touched by this PR.
